name: After § 2
title: 2025 general budget: all sections
part_text: 2 a. Underlines that the salaries and benefits of Commissioners, Members and the President of the Council are very generous; is concerned that such disproportionately high salaries completely alienate those people from everyday lives, needs and struggles; considers, therefore, that allocating more reasonable salaries and benefits would increase the chance of the 2025 budget proposals being more in line with the needs of working people;
